name: Claude of Duty
tagline: A Call-of-Duty-quality FPS generated from a single prompt
description: A full First-Person-Shooter experience in Three.js generated from a single prompt — roughly 55k lines of code across 11 subsystems, with 100% procedural assets. Demonstrates what a capable coding model can produce end-to-end in one shot, from gameplay mechanics to rendering. Purely JavaScript, with 3k stars.
highlights: ~55k lines of Three.js generated from a single prompt
11 subsystems spanning gameplay, rendering, and systems
100% procedural assets — no external art pipeline
Call-of-Duty-quality scope as a stress test for AI generation
curatorNote: A wild benchmark for one-shot AI game generation — worth watching as a proof of what agents can ship.
